verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Shortwave blocking tracking or read-receipt pixels, by default or otherwise. On data transparency, only community comments describe the privacy policy (collecting email contents and metadata, sharing with vendors) and server-side syncing. Those are user critiques, not first-party documentation of transparency controls, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
